chunks: And they came to believe; so We allowed them to enjoy the good things of life for an age.

key_terms.حِينٍ: A period of time / an age

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God allows believers to enjoy life for a while?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the believers of the People of the Book who accepted Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) or, more broadly, to the faithful who were granted a respite in worldly affairs before the final judgment. It underscores the concept of 'imta'' (enjoyment) not merely as a reward, but as a temporary trial that highlights the impermanence of dunya compared to the eternal abode of the Hereafter. This perspective aligns with the Shia emphasis on balancing spiritual devotion with active engagement in the world, recognizing its fleeting nature.
